title: Light over darkness
description:
The text explores how the world and human hearts are filled with a spiritual darkness of sin, suffering, and helplessness that people cannot escape on their own.It presents Jesus Christ as the true light of the world sent by God to conquer this darkness and pay the price for human sins.Readers are invited to place their trust in Jesus to receive forgiveness, guidance, and eternal life free from fear and darkness.

Finally, it encourages believers to grow in this new light by reading the Bible daily.
